text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If we're doing this, I want to make it 
the best Goshiki Shuntaisai in history! 
Let's pool all our efforts together and 
give it everything!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Of cooourse! 
The Goshiki Shuntaisai is a festival meant 
to forge 
a super-duuuper deep bond between 
Umamusume and humans, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Which means if we work super hard~... 
...Eeeek♡

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Just what on earth are you imagining?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet-chan, Maya-chan! 
The briefing for the Shinko is about to 
begin~!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet and Others
text_block_list.text:
Right, on my way! 
I copy☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On this day, the Shinshiko and Shinko 
members 
had gathered at the "Program Venue."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There was a group of humans and Umamusume 
mingling at the venue. 
...They must be the members of the sacred 
ritual organizations. 
One of the Umamusume bows politely, and I 
return the gesture.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
A pleasure to meet you. You must be our 
Tsunade for this occasion. 
We look forward to working with you until 
the grand festival.
choice_data_list:
The pleasure is mine. Thank you for having 
me.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text: And――

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
――Lady Azuma. 
We are profoundly grateful for your 
gracious presence today.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
It is we who shall be in your care. 
...Please, raise your head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The air instantly tightens with reverence. 
...It's clear that to the ritual society 
members, 
she is an exceptionally special Umamusume.
choice_data_list:
(I'd better make sure I'm on my best 
behavior too!)

(I'd better make sure I'm on my best 
behavior too!)

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Hoho, time is limited. 
Moreover, by nature, sacred rituals and 
festivals 
are bound to the livelihood of the land 
and its stewards.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Would you be so kind as to instruct us, 
who are merely borrowing this sacred rite?

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
It would be our honor. 
Then let us begin the "Training Workshop" 
for the rituals. 
Tsunade-san, are you ready as well?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
... 
...How radiant.

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
――"Sacred Flag Contest." 
This is one of the rites comprising "Soma 
Nomaoi," 
a festival boasting over a millennium of 
history.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, the Soma Nomaoi is a rite of 
warriors! 
Spanning three whole days across Fukushima 
Prefecture, 
'tis a truly boisterous and splendid 
affair!
choice_data_list:
So what exactly happens in the Sacred Flag 
Contest?

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, sacred banners are 
launched into the air, 
and as they fall, you must snatch them 
using a special pole. 
Allow me to demonstrate――

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text: Just like that!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And for today's practice, 'tis only me out 
here! 
Why settle for just one? Perhaps I shall 
endeavor 
to seize both banners at once!

text_block_list.name: Soma Nomaoi Executive Committee Member
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! By all means! 
That is what practice is for, after all.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
――"Yabusame." 
It is a sacred ritual wherein an 
Umamusume, 
bearing arrows of purification, shoots at 
ceremonial targets.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Tradition dictates that the arrows and 
targets used are gifted 
to the gathered crowd as lucky charms. 
...Now then, Scarlet-san. Take your arrow.

text_block_list.name: Yabusame Instructor
text_block_list.text: ――――――Magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I've practiced kyudo before, so I know my 
way around a bow. 
I'll fulfill my duty with everything I've 
got!

text_block_list.name: Grand Mikoshi Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
――The "Grand Mikoshi Haul" is an Iwate 
ritual born from 
a culture of hauling auspicious treasures! 
The pullers gotta haul 
it right up and over that bridge archin' 
like a mountain!
choice_data_list: Hauling a massive mikoshi like that...!

text_block_list.name: Grand Mikoshi Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
You betcha! 
That bridge is a heavy monster set up with 
a crane! Even with 
a whole mikoshi bein' dragged across, it 
won't budge an in――

text_block_list.name: Grand Mikoshi Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, haulin' such an enormous mikoshi 
straight up 
a slope that steep gotta be pretty 
terrifying, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no! It ain't that I'm scared or 
nothin'! 
Just lookin' at this bridge got my heart 
goin' pitter-patter!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Honest to goodness, I'm just so happy. 
To think I'd get to take charge of a 
festival from back home, 
one I've watched ever since I was 
knee-high to a grasshopper.

text_block_list.name: Grand Mikoshi Support Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan...! 
Aw, I'm so happy I get to lend a hand 
too~!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, are ya watchin'? 
Everyone's makin' great headway! Things 
are lookin' good♪
choice_data_list:
Next up is your training for "Soaring 
Gallop."

Next up is your training for "Soaring 
Gallop."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! 
Boo's gonna make this a mega-super-huge 
success!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
The Goshiki Shuntaisai is a festival for 
humans and Umamusume. 
If we put our all into it...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...then all of you humans will be happy 
too, right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Yup! Boo knows really, reaaally well! 
Just how much you guys love Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
――And Boo cherishes humans too! That's why 
I've made up my mind to make this Goshiki 
Shuntaisai a triumph.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha. That mindset is precisely 
what matters most for the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us begin the training for 
"Soaring Gallop." 
Soaring Gallop is a sacred rite praying to 
overcome all the hurdles 
and obstacles we Umamusume face throughout 
our lives.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Representing the hardships and walls 
standing before one's dreams, 
we have crafted obstacle course 
contraptions 
for you to leap over, Blast-san.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Got it! I'm gonna hop, skip, and jump over 
'em all! 
Sensei, keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, by all means. 
Here we go: oooone! Twoooo!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Thre―― Owwwwoowwwch~~?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Blast-chan, are you okay~?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine! 
I can get right back to practic――

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Ouch-ouch-ouch...
choice_data_list: Blast, you need to rest for a bit.
Blast, you need to rest for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Okey-dokey! 
Then Maya'll bring some ice to chill it 
down☆

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Boo's so sorry. 
When Mayano has her "Offering Dance" 
rehearsal to do and all.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...? Maya's practice is already all done! 
I memorized everything!

text_block_list.name: Offering Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
She speaks the absolute truth. To think 
she could master 
the entirety of the Offering Dance's 
choreography in a single go...

text_block_list.name: Offering Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Through its steps, the Offering Dance 
absorbs the prayers of 
those gathered and dedicates them to the 
heavens. 
To grasp its true essence in such a short 
span...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's a genius, after all☆ 
You copy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the individual "Training 
Workshops" 
for each program came to an end. 
...However.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, everyone, have you all got your 
drinks? 
To celebrate today's training workshop, 
and in hopes of deepening our bonds from 
here on out~...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume & Society Members
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chatter, laughter, bustling murmurs...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Blast, come join the circle. 
It's a get-together with humans, just the 
way you like it, right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Blast? 
Can you hear me?

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
choice_data_list:
Everyone else picked things up so quickly 
today, which made it harder...

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, everyone. 
Could we perhaps arrange a venue to 
showcase our programs at year's end?
choice_data_list: At the end of this year?

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society President
text_block_list.text:
――! Like a "Progress Showcase"? 
I believe that would be wonderful for 
Blast-san as well! 
Setting a tangible goal can help someone 
reset their mindset.

text_block_list.name: Soaring Gallop Preservation Society Head
text_block_list.text:
Getting accustomed to an audience in a 
setting close to the real thing 
will be of immense benefit to the Shinko. 
...We shall dedicate the entire day to 
supporting you!
choice_data_list: I'm sure Blast will find her motivation!

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Giggle... Then we require a plan. 
A strategy for how to conduct rehearsals 
between now and year's end.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
And most intriguing of all... 
The "Soaring Gallop" ritual overseen by 
Lady Blast is a sacred rite 
where horse and human leap past hurdles 
together.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Many more trials and tribulations are sure 
to follow. 
Now, Trainer. Venerated Shinshiku. 
――Please, lead the way for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Her cool, composed gaze seems to ask: 
"What will you do next?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reach our goal at the end of December, 
how do we overcome the challenges before 
us? 
...I need to think this through with the 
future in mind.
